data.long_description:
Discover modern living in this well-designed studio apartment located in Majan, within the sought-after Samana Barari Lagoons development. Offering a perfect blend of comfort and style, this property is ideal for end-users seeking a cozy home or investors looking for strong rental potential in one of Dubai’s emerging communities.

Property Details:

Property Type: Studio Apartment
Bathroom: 1
Built-up Area: 421.83 sq ft
Community: Samana Barari Lagoons
Location: Majan, Dubailand
Layout: Open-plan living and sleeping area
Condition: Contemporary finishes with modern design

Property Amenities:

Resort-style swimming pool
Fully equipped gymnasium
Landscaped gardens and leisure areas
24/7 security
Covered parking
High-speed elevators
Children’s play area

Location Highlights:

Situated in Majan, a rapidly developing residential hub in Dubailand
Easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
Close to key attractions like Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure
Short drive to Downtown Dubai and major business districts
Nearby schools, supermarkets, and healthcare facilities
Peaceful community environment with future growth potential
